description:
Turn recipes and meal plans from your chat into a grocery list you can shop from and share. Ask for a week of dinners, paste a recipe, or name a dish, and Grocer saves the ingredients with quantities, scaled to your servings. The same ingredient from different recipes is combined into one item, and each item is sorted into its store aisle. Then check items off as you shop, see what's still left, edit or rename items and lists, and share a list with the people you shop with or create an invite link for someone new. Start a new week by copying last week's list, ask what you usually buy to see items from your past lists, check who is on a list, and put its categories in the order of your store's aisles.

Lists are saved to your Grocer account and sync with the Grocer iPhone app and with Grocer in a web browser on any other phone or computer, where everyone on a shared list sees changes as they happen. After an add, a Grocer list card in the chat shows the list, lets you tick items off, and opens it in Grocer.

Made for people who plan meals, cook from recipes, or shop for a household or roommates. Connect a Grocer account to get started; you can create one with email, Apple, or Google while connecting. Shared lists follow each person's permissions. Grocer keeps the list; it does not suggest meals itself, show store prices, or order groceries.

defaultPrompt: Plan three easy dinners for two this week and save the groceries to a Grocer list.
Save the ingredients from this recipe to my Grocer list.
Share my Grocer list with my roommate so we can both add to it.
